presentation_title: 3 Cs of Prompting: Write Effective AI Prompts
learning_objectives: By the end of this tutorial, you will be able to write effective prompts.
outline: Introduction to the 3 Cs of Prompting
prerequisites:
Learners should have basic computer and internet usage skills.
Familiarity with what **AI chatbots** are will be helpful.

slides.title: Welcome to 3 Cs of Prompting
slides.narration:
Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on the **3 Cs** of **Prompting**.
Here, you will learn to write good questions for **AI chatbots**.
This helps you get better answers from **AI**.
slides.image_prompt: Welcome screen for '3 Cs of Prompting' tutorial, featuring stylized icons representing Clarity, Conciseness, and Context, with a friendly AI robot or chatbot character.

slides.title: Learning Objective
slides.narration:
After this tutorial, you will be able to write good questions for **AI chatbots**.
You will use the **3 Cs** method: **Clarity**, **Conciseness**, and **Context**.
slides.image_prompt: A visual representation of learning objectives, with a list icon and a lightbulb for 'understanding AI prompts better', featuring the text 'Clarity', 'Conciseness', 'Context'.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
To follow this tutorial, you need a web browser and internet.
You can use any basic **AI chatbot**.
For example, use **ChatGPT**, **Google Bard**, or **Microsoft Copilot** to practice.
slides.image_prompt: Computer screen showing a web browser with a search bar and a generic chatbot interface, next to a Wi-Fi symbol, indicating internet connection and chatbot access.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
Before you start, you should know how to use a computer and the internet.
It helps if you know what **AI chatbots** are.
Also, know how to open them.
slides.image_prompt: A person sitting at a desk using a laptop, with a thought bubble above showing a simplified icon for an AI chatbot, representing basic computer and internet skills and chatbot familiarity.

slides.title: Introduction: The Problem with AI
slides.narration:
Have you ever got a strange answer from an **AI chatbot**?
This happens when the **AI** does not understand your question well.
The way we ask questions to **AI** is called '**prompting**'.
slides.image_prompt: A confused person looking at a computer screen displaying a nonsensical or irrelevant answer from an AI chatbot, symbolizing miscommunication with AI.

slides.title: Introducing the 3 Cs of Prompting
slides.narration:
To get better answers from **AI**, we use three important rules.
These are called the **3 Cs** of **Prompting**.
They are **Clarity**, **Conciseness**, and **Context**.
Let us look at each one with examples.
slides.image_prompt: Three large, distinct letter 'C's (Clarity, Conciseness, Context) arranged around a central brain or lightbulb icon, representing core principles of AI prompting.

slides.title: C1: Clarity - Be Specific
slides.narration:
**Clarity** means you must be very clear in your question.
Do not use unclear words.
The **AI** must know exactly what you want.
Let us see an example.
slides.image_prompt: A magnifying glass focusing on a crisp, clear word, symbolizing specificity and clarity in communication.

slides.title: C1: Clarity - Example (Bad Prompt)
slides.narration:
Let us try a bad question.
Open your **AI chatbot**.
Type 'Tell me about dogs.'
Press Enter.
The **AI** gives a very general answer.
This is because our question was not clear enough.
slides.image_prompt: A blurred or hazy image of a dog, next to a generic text box saying 'Tell me about dogs', illustrating a lack of clarity in a prompt.

slides.title: C1: Clarity - Example (Good Prompt)
slides.narration:
Now, let us make it clear.
Type the following prompt.
Ask to explain the daily routine of a Golden Retriever dog.
Also, include its food and sleep habits.
Press Enter.
You will see a focused and exact answer.
This is how **clarity** helps.
slides.image_prompt: A clear, focused image of a Golden Retriever engaging in specific activities (eating, sleeping, playing), with a detailed text box showing the specific prompt, demonstrating clarity.

slides.title: C2: Conciseness - Be Brief
slides.narration:
**Conciseness** means to be short and direct.
Use less words to say what you mean.
This helps the **AI** understand quickly.
Let us see an example.
slides.image_prompt: A symbol of a pair of scissors cutting a long, winding string into a short, straight piece, representing brevity and directness.

slides.title: C2: Conciseness - Example (Wordy Prompt)
slides.narration:
Let us try a long question.
Type the following prompt.
First, ask to generate an email for your team.
Next, mention the project deadline is next Friday.
Then, remind them to submit initial drafts by Wednesday.
See the **AI's** answer.
slides.image_prompt: A very long, scrolling text box filled with dense, wordy text, contrasting with a small, efficient AI chatbot icon, demonstrating an overly wordy prompt.

slides.title: C2: Conciseness - Example (Concise Prompt)
slides.narration:
Now, let us be short.
Type the following prompt.
Ask to draft an email to your team.
Mention the project deadline is next Friday.
Remind them to submit initial drafts by Wednesday.
See, the **AI** gives a similar email with a shorter question.
Being short saves time.
slides.image_prompt: A short, focused text box with the concise prompt, next to an email icon, showing an efficient and direct communication with the AI.

slides.title: C3: Context - Provide Background
slides.narration:
**Context** means to give the **AI** background details.
You can tell the **AI** its role, or give special rules.
This helps the **AI** give a better answer.
Let us see an example.
slides.image_prompt: A thought bubble or speech bubble containing various related images and keywords, all leading to a central question mark, illustrating the provision of background information.

slides.title: C3: Context - Example (No Context)
slides.narration:
Let us try a question without **context**.
Type: 'Write a short story about a hero.'
Press Enter.
The **AI** gives a common story.
It does not know what hero or place you like.
slides.image_prompt: A generic, archetypal hero figure in a bland, unspecific setting, with a simple text box saying 'Write a short story about a hero', depicting a lack of context.

slides.title: C3: Context - Example (With Context)
slides.narration:
Now, let us add **context**.
Type the following prompt.
First, set the **AI's** role as a fantasy writer.
Ask for a 150-word story about a reluctant hero.
State that he must save a magical forest.
Specify from a dark sorcerer.
Press Enter.
See, the story is now more specific and creative.
This is because we gave **context**.
slides.image_prompt: A detailed fantasy scene with a reluctant hero, a magical forest, and a dark sorcerer, alongside a text box showing the prompt with specific contextual roles and elements.

slides.title: Putting the 3 Cs Together
slides.narration:
The best questions use all **3 Cs**: **Clarity**, **Conciseness**, and **Context**.
For example, you can ask for a recipe.
Start by setting the **AI's** role as a professional chef.
Ask for a concise recipe for a simple vegetarian pasta dish.
Specify that it should be prepared in under 30 minutes.
Also, mention using common pantry ingredients.
Finally, ask to focus on flavor and ease of preparation.
This question is clear, short, and gives background to the **AI**.
slides.image_prompt: A visual representation combining the three C's (Clarity, Conciseness, Context) with arrows pointing to a fully formed, effective prompt example, showcasing a well-crafted vegetarian pasta recipe.

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, we learned about the **3 Cs** of **Prompting**.
**Clarity** means being specific.
**Conciseness** means being short.
**Context** means giving background details.
Using these helps you get better answers from **AI**.
slides.image_prompt: A summary slide with bullet points or icons representing Clarity (magnifying glass), Conciseness (scissors), and Context (thought bubble), with a checkmark indicating understanding.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
For your homework, choose two different tasks.
For example, ask for travel help or write a social media post.
For each task, write two questions.
Write one bad question.
Then, write one good question.
Make sure to use the **3 Cs** for the good one.
Test them on an **AI chatbot** and compare the results.
slides.image_prompt: A notebook and pen with two distinct task icons (e.g., a suitcase for travel, a social media icon for a post), showing 'Good Prompt' and 'Bad Prompt' comparisons.
